newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange to list thread maker Ceytas.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange to list thread maker Ceytas.

text.p: The Istanbul Stock Exchange said Turkish thread producer Ceytas Ceyhan Tekstil Sanayii A.S. would be listed on the national market on March 3.
It said the opening price would be 3,300 lira per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share, unchanged from the initial price set in the public offer, the Exchange said.

Offer manager Global securities said 70.24 percent of the 168 billion lira nominal offer was sold to 47,948 domestic investors and the rest to 12 foreign institutional investors in the two-day offer from February 20.
Turkish Smaller Companies Fund bought 5.95 percent of the total offer, Global said, adding that the domestic tranche was oversubscribed.
After the public sale, Turgay Ciner remained as the biggest shareholder with 39.5 percent stake in the company's 600 billion lira capital. His previous stake was 54.86 percent.
Textile firm Cinteks Pamuk Ipligi Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. held 21.37 percent stake, down from previous 29.68 percent.
The proceeds from the offering would be used to retire debt incurred in connection with investments by the company for modernization and capacity increases, Global said.
Ceytas posted 180.6 billion lira of net profits in the first nine months of 1996. Sales totalled to 6,176 tonnes and exports were $1.7 million in the same period.
